name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-document-library
title: Business Document Library
shortDescription: Browse folders and files in a configured SharePoint document library.
longDescription: A React SharePoint Framework web part for safely browsing a configured document library or library folder.
It reads bounded file and folder metadata with PnPjs and provides SharePoint open, download, folder navigation, and refresh actions.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
references.description: Client-side web parts run in the context of a SharePoint page and can be built with modern JavaScript web frameworks.
